raw.rationale: This launched COX inhibitor (likely a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug such as celecoxib or diclofenac) has no known broad cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 µM, and PRISM single-agent screens of NSAIDs typically show weak, non-lineage-selective viability effects; any apparent lineage selectivity would be rare and driven mainly by COX-2 expression in colorectal, gastric, and upper aerodigestive tumors, but effect sizes rarely reach the required -0.5 log2FC threshold.
